newsitem.title: USA: Home Shopping, BET to halt black shopping program.
newsitem.headline: Home Shopping, BET to halt black shopping program.

text.p: Home Shopping Network Inc and Black Entertainment Television Inc, whose parent company is BET Holdings Inc, said on Tuesday they had agreed to end production of BET Shop, an experimental shopping program targeted towards black consumers.
The companies said in a statement BET Shop premiered on BET September 1994. It will continue to air on BET in its regular time slot 5 p.m. EDT on Saturday through December 1996.
Home Shopping Network and BET have deemed the test programming as successful, both in terms of audience reach and product movement, the statement said.
"BET will continue to explore the potential of a black-oriented shopping channel as digital technology develops," it said.
